strategy.observation: Linear designs workflows shared by people and AI agents, including drafting PRDs and pushing PRs.
strategy.offer_link: Interview participants could help Linear’s product team learn how customers want people and AI agents to collaborate across these workflows, informing product decisions.
hypotheses: Linear may be seeking more customer input on how these workflows work in practice.
The Head of Product may be involved in deciding when and how to gather that input.
strategy.angle: Since Linear’s workflows are designed for people and AI agents to work together, I wondered how you’re gathering customer input on where that collaboration works best.
strategy.fit_reason: Customer interviews are directly relevant to understanding how users experience product workflows, and the human-and-agent collaboration described in fact 3 gives the offer a specific connection to Linear’s product.

draft.subject: Customer input on agent workflows
draft.body:
Since Linear’s workflows are designed for people and AI agents to work together, I wondered how you’re gathering customer input on where that collaboration works best.

I recruit and schedule customer interview participants for product teams, so teams can hear directly how people use these workflows and where they want agents involved. If you’re looking at this now, would it help to interview a few users specifically about drafting PRDs or pushing PRs?
